```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
floodnet_df <- read.csv("FloodNet_data.csv")
head(floodnet_df)
str(floodnet_df)
summary(floodnet_df)


```
```{r}

numeric_columns <- sapply(floodnet_df, is.numeric)
names(floodnet_df)[numeric_columns]
```

```{r}
ggplot(floodnet_df, aes(x = Duration.of.Flooding.Greater.Than.12.Inches..minutes.)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "blue",  bins = 10) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Flood Duration > 12in (mins)  \n (All Rain Events & Sensors. Nov 20 - Oct 2026)", x = "Duration (mins)", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_classic()+theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(paste("Mean of Flood Duration > 12in:", mean(floodnet_df$Duration.of.Flooding.Greater.Than.12.Inches..minutes., na.rm = TRUE)))
print(paste("Median of Flood Duration > 12in:", median(floodnet_df$Duration.of.Flooding.Greater.Than.12.Inches..minutes., na.rm = TRUE)))

```
```{r}
 ggplot(floodnet_df, aes(x = Duration.of.Flooding.Greater.Than.24.Inches..minutes.))+
  geom_histogram(fill = "blue", bins = 10) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Flood Duration > 24in (mins) \n (All Rain Events & Sensors. Nov 20 - Oct 2026)", x = "Duration (mins)", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(paste("Mean of Flood Duration > 24in:", mean(floodnet_df$Duration.of.Flooding.Greater.Than.24.Inches..minutes., na.rm = TRUE)))
print(paste("Median of Flood Duration > 24in:", median(floodnet_df$Duration.of.Flooding.Greater.Than.24.Inches..minutes., na.rm = TRUE)))

```
```{r}
hist(floodnet_df$Duration.of.Flooding.Greater.Than.24.Inches..minutes.)
```
```{r}

top_sensors <- floodnet_df %>% 
  count(Sensor.Name) %>% 
  top_n(15, n) %>% 
  pull(Sensor.Name)


ggplot(filter(floodnet_df, Sensor.Name %in% top_sensors), aes(x = Sensor.Name)) + 
  geom_bar(fill = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Top 15 Sensor Names", x = "Sensor Name", y = "Count") +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
